esa_hreda_headward_fluid_shift.name: ESA HREDA - Headward Fluid Shift (HeadwardFluidShift_PARA)
esa_hreda_headward_fluid_shift.campaign: 82nd ESA (NASA) Parabolic Flight Campaign, 12-15 June 2023, Novespace A310 ZERO-G
esa_hreda_headward_fluid_shift.conditions: ground 1G supine + seated; in flight seated 0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 G and 1G level flight
esa_hreda_headward_fluid_shift.variables: IJV cross-sectional area, IJV flow pattern, IJV pressure (compression sonography)
esa_hreda_headward_fluid_shift.access: HREDA TAP: data_available=False, 0 data files, results 'under evaluation' (checked 2026-11-04). Only route: contact PI Stuart M. C. Lee (team: D. S. Martin, C. Miller).

lee2020_partial_gravity.name: Lee et al. 2020, Venous and Arterial Responses to Partial Gravity
lee2020_partial_gravity.campaign: 1st ISLSWG parabolic flight campaign, June 2018, Novespace (NOT PFC82; no 0-G parabolas)
lee2020_partial_gravity.variables: IJV area (n=8), IVC diameter, CCA flow & area, IJV flow grade, HR, MAP; IJV pressure only for a subset (6 subjects; none seated at 0.75/1.00 Gz)
lee2020_partial_gravity.access: Group means/95% CI transcribed from Tables 2-3 into data/external. Individual data: request via NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (https://lsda.jsc.nasa.gov/).

marshall_goebel2019_iss_ijv.name: Marshall-Goebel et al. 2019, Jugular Venous Flow Stasis During Spaceflight
marshall_goebel2019_iss_ijv.campaign: ISS long-duration crew (n=11), preflight seated/supine/15deg HDT, flight day ~50 and ~150 (+/- LBNP 25 mmHg), postflight
marshall_goebel2019_iss_ijv.variables: left IJV area, IJV pressure, IJV flow grade, SV, CO, HR, MAP, SBP, DBP
marshall_goebel2019_iss_ijv.access: Group means/95% CI transcribed from text and Table into data/external. Individual data: NASA LSDA request.
marshall_goebel2019_iss_ijv.license: CC BY (JAMA Netw Open open access)

physionet_prcp.name: PhysioNet PRCP - Physiologic Response to Changes in Posture
physionet_prcp.conditions: supine rest, slow tilt, fast tilt (to 75 deg), stand-up; tilt-angle timeline in annotations
physionet_prcp.variables: ECG, continuous arterial blood pressure (beat-level HR, MAP derivable)

physionet_cardioresp_orthostat.name: PhysioNet - Two-tiered response of cardiorespiratory-cerebrovascular networks to orthostatic challenge
physionet_cardioresp_orthostat.conditions: 30 min rest (sitting), 1 min stand-up, 1 min sit-down
physionet_cardioresp_orthostat.variables: ABP, cardiac cycle duration, breath interval, cerebral BFV (TCD), NIRS raw intensities (HbO/HbR/HbT derivable)
physionet_cardioresp_orthostat.access: Open (no login); PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0
physionet_cardioresp_orthostat.license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0

bhp_carotid_jugular.name: Whittle & Diaz-Artiles 2023 - carotid and jugular characteristics in graded HUT/HDT
bhp_carotid_jugular.conditions: seated; supine and prone tilt +45..-45 deg in 15 deg steps (gz_body +0.71..-0.71)
bhp_carotid_jugular.variables: IJV area L/R (mm2, n=11), IJV pressure L/R (compression sonography), CCA area L/R
bhp_carotid_jugular.access: Public GitHub repo (no login), pinned commit in the download manifest

bhp_tilt_dose_response.name: Whittle et al. 2022 JAHA - tilt gravitational dose-response (superset, 24 subjects)
bhp_tilt_dose_response.conditions: same tilt protocol as bhp_carotid_jugular, 12 F / 12 M
bhp_tilt_dose_response.variables: HR, SBP/DBP/MAP, SV, CO (Finapres), IJV area L/R, IJV pressure L/R, intraocular pressure L/R, CCA area
bhp_tilt_dose_response.access: Public GitHub repo WITHOUT licence: internal analysis only; ask A. Diaz-Artiles (adartiles@tamu.edu) before publishing per-subject data or derived figures
bhp_tilt_dose_response.license: none stated (all rights reserved by default); article CC BY

bhp_lbnp_dose_response.name: BHP-Lab LBNP dose-response raw data
bhp_lbnp_dose_response.conditions: seated; supine and 15 deg HDT with LBNP 0, -10 ... -50 mmHg
bhp_lbnp_dose_response.variables: HR, BP, SV, CO, IJV area L/R, IJV pressure L/R, IOP L/R, CCA area (+ IJV flow, CCA PSV/EDV, OPP not mapped: units undocumented)
bhp_lbnp_dose_response.access: Public GitHub repo WITHOUT licence: internal analysis only; ask the authors before publishing

hreda_drain_brain.name: ESA HREDA - Drain Brain (ISS, strain-gauge plethysmography of jugular outflow)
hreda_drain_brain.variables: cervical venous plethysmography (see Taibi et al. 2017, Physiol Meas 38:1939)
hreda_drain_brain.access: HREDA lists only a Data Blank Book PDF (medical_sensitive=True); download needs an ESA/HREDA login; raw data via HREDA data request.

hreda_bed_rest_blank_books.name: ESA HREDA - head-down bed-rest studies (Cocktail, MNX, NUC, BRAG, RSL)
hreda_bed_rest_blank_books.access: Each lists only Data Blank Book PDFs (variable catalogues). Raw data via HREDA data request.

ubfc_rppg.name: UBFC-rPPG (DATASET_1 simple, DATASET_2 realistic)
ubfc_rppg.variables: uncompressed 640x480 RGB @30 fps (Logitech C920) + CMS50E finger PPG waveform and HR
ubfc_rppg.access: Public mirrors linked from the official page (no login): authors' OneDrive/SharePoint (used; Google Drive mirror hits 'too many downloads' quota). ~92 GB uncompressed AVI.
ubfc_rppg.license: Research use; cite Bobbia et al. 2017. DATASET_2 subjects 21 and 27: facial images must NOT appear in any publication/presentation/report (readme.txt).

physionet_videopulse.name: PhysioNet videopulse - Video Pulse Signals in Stationary and Motion Conditions
physionet_videopulse.variables: pre-extracted video pulse signals + finger pulse reference (no raw video)

pure.name: PURE (TU Ilmenau)
pure.access: e-mail request to the authors (Stricker et al. 2014)

mmpd.name: MMPD (mobile, skin tones, motion)
mmpd.access: signed agreement e-mailed to the authors

hreda_epo_uznanski_videos.name: ESA HREDA - EPO Uznanski Generic Videos (Ignis, ISS 2025)
hreda_epo_uznanski_videos.variables: 182 files (123 MOV, 11 MP4, 47 JPEG), 30.5 GB; astronaut face video in microgravity, no physiological GT
hreda_epo_uznanski_videos.access: Files public (access_granted, security level 0-1) but download needs an HREDA login.
hreda_epo_uznanski_videos.license: ESA EPO material - check terms before publishing frames

synthetic_esa_like_cohort.name: esa_loader.generate_synthetic_esa_like_cohort() (formerly get_verified_published_cohort) - 9x5 table
synthetic_esa_like_cohort.access: Generated with np.random (seed 42) around Lee 2020 group means; IJV pressure, supine HR/MAP and 0.75/1.00-G pressures are NOT in the paper at all.

synthetic_rppg_cohort.name: rppg_loader.generate_synthetic_rppg_session()
synthetic_rppg_cohort.access: Sinusoidal pulse + noise RGB traces; no video.
